section: Urbanisation in India - trends, class-size of towns, million-plus cities, urban agglomerations

accepted.s: The Smart Cities Mission was launched in which year as a Centrally Sponsored Scheme?
accepted.x: The Smart Cities Mission was launched in 2015 as a Centrally Sponsored Scheme.
accepted.tq: Use the year-based direct-recall method and distinguish neighbouring launch years.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes - Smart Cities, AMRUT, HRIDAY, PMAY-Urban  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Smart Cities Mission:
1. One hundred cities were selected under the mission.
2. The selection was conducted in four rounds between January 2016 and June 2018.
3. The Centre's support under the mission was ₹48,000 crore.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: 100 cities were selected in four rounds from January 2016 to June 2018, with central support of ₹48,000 crore.
accepted.tq: Check each numerical statement separately before selecting the combined code.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes - Smart Cities, AMRUT, HRIDAY, PMAY-Urban  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following cities of Andhra Pradesh is included in the Smart Cities Mission?
accepted.x: Visakhapatnam is one of the cities included in the Smart Cities Mission.
accepted.tq: Apply the location-based recall method using nearby Andhra Pradesh urban centres as distractors.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes - Smart Cities, AMRUT, HRIDAY, PMAY-Urban  [APPSC]

accepted.s: AMRUT was launched on:
accepted.x: The Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation was launched on 25 June 2015.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the exact day and month from other common national mission dates.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes - Smart Cities, AMRUT, HRIDAY, PMAY-Urban  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the coverage of AMRUT?
o: 485 cities initially, increased to 500 after mergers
100 cities initially, increased to 500 after mergers
500 cities, with no change after mergers
500 cities initially, reduced to 485 after mergers
accepted.x: AMRUT initially covered 500 cities; the number became 485 after 15 mergers.
accepted.tq: Split the option into initial coverage and post-merger coverage.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes - Smart Cities, AMRUT, HRIDAY, PMAY-Urban  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The financial outlay associated with AMRUT is approximately:
accepted.x: AMRUT has an allocation of approximately ₹1 lakh crore.
accepted.tq: Compare the financial figures of the parent mission and its successor mission.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes - Smart Cities, AMRUT, HRIDAY, PMAY-Urban  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Up to which period has AMRUT been extended?
accepted.x: AMRUT has been extended up to September 2025.
accepted.tq: Use the precise end-date trap rather than relying only on the launch year.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes - Smart Cities, AMRUT, HRIDAY, PMAY-Urban  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding AMRUT 2.0:
1. It covers the period 2021-22 to 2025-26.
2. Its total outlay is ₹2,99,000 crore, including a Central share of ₹76,760 crore.
3. It aims to provide water security to about 4,800 towns.
4. It aims at 100 per cent sewerage in 500 cities.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements correctly describe AMRUT 2.0, including its period, financial structure, water-security coverage and sewerage target.
accepted.tq: Verify the period, amount, coverage and target independently before choosing the full combination.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes - Smart Cities, AMRUT, HRIDAY, PMAY-Urban  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: AMRUT 2.0 — 2.03 crore tap connections and 1.50 crore sewer connections given
Smart Cities Mission — 2.03 crore sewer connections given
accepted.x: AMRUT 2.0 is associated with 2.03 crore tap connections and 1.50 crore sewer connections provided.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure mission–indicator pair and reject swapped programme outcomes.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes - Smart Cities, AMRUT, HRIDAY, PMAY-Urban  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
With reference to AMRUT, consider the following statements:
1. It covers ULBs of cities with a population of one lakh or more.
2. It includes State capitals and HRIDAY cities.
3. It covers approximately 65 per cent of India's urban population.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: AMRUT covers ULBs of cities with one lakh or more population, State capitals and HRIDAY cities, representing about 65 per cent of the urban population.
accepted.tq: Test eligibility, special categories and population share as separate components.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes - Smart Cities, AMRUT, HRIDAY, PMAY-Urban  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The primary focus of HRIDAY is:
o: Urban housing for economically weaker sections
accepted.x: HRIDAY is concerned with the development of heritage cities.
accepted.tq: Use the mission-purpose association and eliminate schemes with different sectoral objectives.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes - Smart Cities, AMRUT, HRIDAY, PMAY-Urban  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements regarding HRIDAY is correct?
o: It was implemented only in rural clusters.
Amaravati was one of its 12 cities.
It provided sewerage facilities to 500 cities.
accepted.x: Amaravati in Andhra Pradesh was one of the 12 cities covered under HRIDAY.
accepted.tq: Use the distinctive place-and-number combination to discriminate among schemes.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes - Smart Cities, AMRUT, HRIDAY, PMAY-Urban  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which scheme covers the cities included under HRIDAY for urban rejuvenation?
accepted.x: AMRUT covers the cities included under HRIDAY.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between complementary missions by identifying the scheme that absorbs the heritage-city category.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes - Smart Cities, AMRUT, HRIDAY, PMAY-Urban  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The basic objective of PMAY-U is to provide:
o: Free municipal bonds to all urban local bodies
Water connections to all rural households
Pucca houses to all eligible urban households
Heritage conservation grants to selected cities
accepted.x: PMAY-U seeks to provide pucca houses to all eligible urban households.
accepted.tq: Match the scheme with its core beneficiary-oriented objective.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes - Smart Cities, AMRUT, HRIDAY, PMAY-Urban  [APPSC]

accepted.s: PMAY-U 2.0 targets how many households in five years and involves approximately what total investment?
accepted.x: The stated target is 1 crore households in five years with approximately ₹10 lakh crore of total investment.
accepted.tq: Keep the target and investment figures together and distinguish them from assistance figures.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes - Smart Cities, AMRUT, HRIDAY, PMAY-Urban  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following initiatives is competition-based and has an outlay of ₹1 lakh crore?
accepted.x: The Urban Challenge Fund is a competition-based initiative with an outlay of ₹1 lakh crore.
accepted.tq: Match the distinctive financing mechanism with the corresponding initiative.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes - Smart Cities, AMRUT, HRIDAY, PMAY-Urban  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about City Economic Regions:
1. They were provided for in the Union Budget 2026-27.
2. The provision is ₹5,000 crore per region over five years.
3. They are associated with the Urban Challenge Fund of ₹1 lakh crore.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: City Economic Regions were provided for in Budget 2026-27 with ₹5,000 crore per region over five years. The ₹1 lakh crore competition-based fund is a separate Urban Challenge Fund.
accepted.tq: Separate closely related budget announcements instead of combining their amounts.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes - Smart Cities, AMRUT, HRIDAY, PMAY-Urban  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Under the Andhra Pradesh component of AMRUT 2.0, ₹8,517.69 crore has been allocated for how many Urban Local Bodies?
accepted.x: The Andhra Pradesh component provides ₹8,517.69 crore for 113 ULBs.
accepted.tq: Pair the State-specific allocation with its exact institutional coverage.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes - Smart Cities, AMRUT, HRIDAY, PMAY-Urban  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT an urban-rejuvenation programme?
accepted.x: The SPM Rurban Mission is concerned with rural clusters showing urban traits and is not an urban-rejuvenation programme.
accepted.tq: Find the one programme whose target area is rural rather than urban.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes - Smart Cities, AMRUT, HRIDAY, PMAY-Urban  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The SPM Rurban Mission is administered by the:
o: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
accepted.x: The SPM Rurban Mission is administered by the Ministry of Rural Development and focuses on rural clusters showing urban traits.
accepted.tq: Apply the 'who administers the programme?' trap to distinguish neighbouring ministries.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes - Smart Cities, AMRUT, HRIDAY, PMAY-Urban  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: PMAY-U 2.0 — 1 crore families, ₹2.30 lakh crore assistance, up to 2028-29
SBM-U 2.0 — heritage city development, ₹1.41 lakh crore
SPM Rurban Mission — 100 Smart Cities, ₹48,000 crore
Smart Cities Mission — 1 crore urban families, ₹2.30 lakh crore assistance
accepted.x: PMAY-U 2.0 targets 1 crore families, provides ₹2.30 lakh crore assistance and extends up to 2028-29.
accepted.tq: Check the programme, beneficiary target, amount and time period as one matched set.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes - Smart Cities, AMRUT, HRIDAY, PMAY-Urban  [APPSC]

accepted.s: SBM-U 2.0 was launched on 1 October 2021 with the objective of developing:
accepted.x: SBM-U 2.0 was launched on 1 October 2021 with the objective of creating Garbage Free cities.
accepted.tq: Use the exact slogan or objective to distinguish similarly named urban missions.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes - Smart Cities, AMRUT, HRIDAY, PMAY-Urban  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The outlay associated with SBM-U 2.0 is:
accepted.x: SBM-U 2.0 has an outlay of ₹1.41 lakh crore.
accepted.tq: Compare similarly large mission outlays and select the exact figure.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes - Smart Cities, AMRUT, HRIDAY, PMAY-Urban  [APPSC]

accepted.s: As on 11 July 2025, how many projects under the Smart Cities Mission had been completed out of 8,063 projects?
accepted.x: A total of 7,636 out of 8,063 projects, or 95 per cent, had been completed as on 11 July 2025.
accepted.tq: Distinguish completed projects from total projects and retain the exact date benchmark.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes - Smart Cities, AMRUT, HRIDAY, PMAY-Urban  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The total of 7,935 towns comprises:
accepted.x: The total consists of 4,041 statutory towns and 3,894 Census Towns.
accepted.tq: Break the aggregate into its two components before evaluating the options.
accepted.sec: Census towns growth and hidden urbanisation  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which estimate stated that 55.3 per cent of Indians lived in urban-like areas in 2010?
o: EAC-PM estimate based on satellite data
accepted.x: The World Bank estimated in 2010 that 55.3 per cent of Indians lived in urban-like areas.
accepted.tq: Match the percentage with the institution and year rather than recalling the percentage alone.
accepted.sec: Census towns growth and hidden urbanisation  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The EAC-PM estimated urbanisation at approximately 63 per cent in 2015 on the basis of:
accepted.x: The EAC-PM estimate of possibly 63 per cent urbanisation in 2015 was based on satellite data.
accepted.tq: Identify the distinctive data source attached to the estimate.
accepted.sec: Census towns growth and hidden urbanisation  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which organisation's ASICS 2023 report also indicated that India's urbanisation was substantially greater than shown by the Census?
accepted.x: Janaagraha's ASICS 2023 report pointed to much more urbanisation than reflected in the Census.
accepted.tq: Match the named report with its issuing organisation.
accepted.sec: Census towns growth and hidden urbanisation  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is a statutory town?
o: Any continuous urban spread formed by two contiguous towns
Only a village satisfying the three Census Town criteria
Any area that is not classified as rural
A place notified with a municipality, corporation, cantonment board or notified town area committee
accepted.x: A statutory town is a place notified with a municipality, municipal corporation, cantonment board or notified town area committee and run by a ULB.
accepted.tq: Distinguish administrative status from Census-based demographic classification.
accepted.sec: Census towns growth and hidden urbanisation  [APPSC]

accepted.s: An urban agglomeration is best defined as:
o: Any urban area with one lakh or more population
A rural cluster displaying urban occupational structure
A statutory town administered by a municipal corporation only
A continuous urban spread comprising a town with outgrowths or two or more contiguous towns
accepted.x: An urban agglomeration is a continuous urban spread consisting of a town and its outgrowths or two or more contiguous towns.
accepted.tq: Use the definition's structural elements—continuity, outgrowths and contiguity—to reject partial descriptions.
accepted.sec: Census towns growth and hidden urbanisation  [APPSC]

accepted.s: A million-plus or metropolitan city has a population of:
accepted.x: A million-plus or metropolitan city has a population of 10 lakh or more.
accepted.tq: Convert the term 'million-plus' into the Indian population unit used in the question.
accepted.sec: Census towns growth and hidden urbanisation  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Under Article 243P, a metropolitan area means an area having a population of:
accepted.x: Article 243P defines a metropolitan area as an area with a population of 10 lakh or more.
accepted.tq: Pair the constitutional Article with its population threshold.
accepted.sec: Census towns growth and hidden urbanisation  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes a rural area for the purpose of the urban-rural classification?
o: An area without any agricultural workers
An area outside a metropolitan region only
An area that is not urban
An area having fewer than 5,000 people only
accepted.x: A rural area is defined residually as any area that is not urban.
accepted.tq: Identify the residual category rather than imposing an unsupported population threshold.
accepted.sec: Census towns growth and hidden urbanisation  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Delhi Development Authority prepares which plan?
accepted.x: The Delhi Development Authority prepares the Delhi Master Plan, MPD-2021.
accepted.tq: Match the institution with its specific planning document.
accepted.sec: Urban planning institutions - FIRST UDA, 74th Amendment ULBs  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The 74th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992 came into force on:
accepted.x: The 74th Amendment Act, 1992 came into force on 1 June 1993.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the enactment year from the date on which the amendment became operative.
accepted.sec: Urban planning institutions - FIRST UDA, 74th Amendment ULBs  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The 74th Constitutional Amendment inserted:
o: Part IX and the Eleventh Schedule
Part IXA and the Twelfth Schedule
Part X and the Twelfth Schedule
Part IXB and the Eleventh Schedule
accepted.x: The 74th Amendment inserted Part IXA and the Twelfth Schedule into the Constitution.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between the constitutional parts and schedules associated with rural and urban local bodies.
accepted.sec: Urban planning institutions - FIRST UDA, 74th Amendment ULBs  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: How many functions are included in the Twelfth Schedule?
accepted.x: The Twelfth Schedule contains 18 functions for urban local bodies.
accepted.tq: Use the schedule-number and function-count pair as a linked constitutional fact.
accepted.sec: Urban planning institutions - FIRST UDA, 74th Amendment ULBs  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT included among the functions associated with the Twelfth Schedule?
accepted.x: Urban planning, slum improvement, urban forestry and poverty alleviation are among the listed urban functions. Inter-State river-water dispute settlement is not a Twelfth Schedule function.
accepted.tq: Find the option outside the urban-local-body functional domain.
accepted.sec: Urban planning institutions - FIRST UDA, 74th Amendment ULBs  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II:
List-I (Urban Local Body)
a. Nagar Panchayat
b. Municipal Council
c. Municipal Corporation
List-II (Area)
i. Larger urban area
ii. Area in transition from rural to urban
 iii. Smaller urban area

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: A Nagar Panchayat serves an area in transition, a Municipal Council serves a smaller urban area, and a Municipal Corporation serves a larger urban area.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure pair and match each local body with its constitutional area category.
accepted.sec: Urban planning institutions - FIRST UDA, 74th Amendment ULBs  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
accepted.x: Article 243ZD provides for the District Planning Committee, while Article 243ZE provides for the Metropolitan Planning Committee.
accepted.tq: Separate the two similarly named planning committees by their Article numbers.
accepted.sec: Urban planning institutions - FIRST UDA, 74th Amendment ULBs  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The National Commission on Urbanisation, constituted in 1985, was chaired by:
accepted.x: The National Commission on Urbanisation constituted in 1985 was chaired by Charles Correa.
accepted.tq: Match the commission with its chairperson and reject unrelated famous names.
accepted.sec: Urban planning institutions - FIRST UDA, 74th Amendment ULBs  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the 16th Finance Commission grants to Urban Local Bodies:
1. ₹3.6 lakh crore has been provided for ULBs.
2. The urban share has risen from 36 per cent to 45 per cent.
3. A one-time Urbanisation Premium is proposed for merging peri-urban villages.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct regarding the 16th Finance Commission's 2026-31 grants to ULBs.
accepted.tq: Check the grant amount, percentage change and special premium as separate fiscal provisions.
accepted.sec: Urban planning institutions - FIRST UDA, 74th Amendment ULBs  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Under the Union Budget 2026-27 provision, the incentive for a single municipal bond issue above ₹1,000 crore is:
accepted.x: A ₹100 crore incentive is provided for a single municipal bond issue above ₹1,000 crore.
accepted.tq: Keep the eligibility threshold and incentive amount distinct while reading the numerical option.
